pose: Static authored pose; animations and procedural Blender shading are represented by the original media.
optimization: Prune unused data, deduplicate, instance repeated meshes, and Draco-compress.
preview_note: The 3D preview opens close to the car; dust volumes are omitted so the vehicle remains visible.
color_policy: Representative colors are read from the original Blender shaders before material deduplication. Existing image textures are preserved.
